body.purpose: Table cells, form text, descriptions. Set in SN Pro.

label.purpose: Tabs, badges, small buttons, table headers; bold only for the active nav item.

mono.purpose: Chakra default mono stack; rarely used.

components.name: Brand Logo
components.description: Official Toscana logo via BrandLogo (variant horizontal|vertical, height px); ink on light, cream on dark, swapped with Chakra _dark. Navbar: horizontal 36px; login: vertical tagline lockup 150px.
components.css: .ds-logo { display: inline-flex; } .ds-logo img { height: 36px; width: auto; } .ds-logo-cream { display: none; } .dark .ds-logo-ink { display: none; } .dark .ds-logo-cream { display: block; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Single primary action of a view (e.g. Iniciar sesión, Exportar CSV).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #ff7078; color: #2a1215; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font: 500 0.875rem/1 'SN Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #ff7078 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f74a55; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action next to a primary (e.g. Exportar PDF).
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: #fff; color: #1c1718; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #e7dfda; border-radius: 4px; font: 500 0.875rem/1 'SN Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #f6f1ee; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f74a55; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Outline Button
components.description: Logout and other destructive or exit actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: transparent; color: #dc2626; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #fca5a5; border-radius: 4px; font: 500 0.875rem/1 'SN Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #fef2f2; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #dc2626; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Audience Badge
components.description: Marks which price list the visitor sees.
components.css: .ds-badge-audience { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #fff4f4; color: #9c1d2a; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 2px; font: 500 0.75rem/1.33 'SN Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Restriction Tag
components.description: Allergen/restriction tag under a product name.
components.css: .ds-badge-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #f1ebe7; color: #5e5553; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 2px; font: 500 0.75rem/1.33 'SN Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Portal Tab Bar
components.description: Underline tabs; active = bold + coral text + coral underline + aria-current.
components.html: InicioMis pedidosCarritoCuenta
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; border-bottom: 1px solid #f1ebe7; font-family: 'SN Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #5e5553; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #1c1718; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f74a55; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-tab[aria-current='page'] { color: #9c1d2a; font-weight: 700; border-bottom-color: #ff7078; }

components.name: Price Table
components.description: Striped outline table; prices right-aligned, es-AR format.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; border: 1px solid #e7dfda; border-radius: 6px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.43 'SN Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: #1c1718; } .ds-table th { text-align: left; font-weight: 500; color: #5e5553; padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e7dfda; } .ds-table td { padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e7dfda; } .ds-table tbody tr:nth-child(odd) { background: #f6f1ee; } .ds-table .ds-num { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
Toscana Pastry is the shop's ledger: prices, stock, orders, and budgets kept in one honest book. The interface exists to make numbers trustworthy and easy to scan. Tables, clear labels, and plain-sans text carry the work. Ornament stays out of the way of the figures.

The system is Chakra UI v3 plus the Toscana brand palette. The brand has an official logo (a rosette with the "Toscana" lettering, optionally with the tagline "Horneando momentos") and four brand colors: coral #ff7078, peach #f5ccad, sage #cce0c9, and teal #75bda3. The `brand` scale is built around coral. There is no product imagery. The typeface is SN Pro. Light and dark modes: white panels on a warm flour-paper #fbf8f6 canvas in light, stepped cocoa near-black surfaces in dark. Mode follows the OS until the user toggles it in the navbar (next-themes, `dark` class on `<html>`). The admin side is a desktop work surface; the customer portal is a mobile path entered from a WhatsApp link.

The confirmed intent for components is **warm and approachable**: friendlier corners and more breathing room than the current defaults, especially on customer-facing screens. The current code does not yet deliver that; new work should move toward it without breaking the ledger's clarity.
keyCharacteristics: Chakra UI v3 plus the Toscana brand palette; single action accent (coral `brand`), warm neutrals.
Official logo rendered through `BrandLogo`, ink in light mode and cream in dark.
Light and dark modes via Chakra semantic tokens; thin warm rules in both.
Tables are the primary data surface (catalog, orders, ingredients).
Active state never relies on color alone (bold weight + underline), per WCAG 2.1 AA.
Toasts via `goey-toast`, Spanish (es-AR) copy, es-AR number formatting.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Coral `brand` is the only action accent. Peach is its wash, never a second accent. Teal and sage carry positive state only (through the `green` palette), never actions or decoration. Status colors (red, green, orange) mean state, never decoration.

rules.name: The Semantic Token Rule
rules.body: Use semantic tokens (`bg`, `bg.panel`, `fg`, `fg.muted`, `border`, `<palette>.fg`, `<palette>.solid`) and never raw shades (`gray.200`, `brand.600`, hex). Raw shades do not switch with the mode.

rules.name: The Role-Not-Default Rule
rules.body: Every `<Button>` declares its role: `colorPalette="brand"` (primary), `variant="outline"` (secondary), `variant="ghost"` (tertiary/nav) or `colorPalette="red"` (destructive). A bare `<Button>` falls back to Chakra's gray solid, which renders white in dark mode.

rules.name: The Weight-Means-State Rule
rules.body: Bold in navigation marks the current page. Don't use bold for decoration in nav.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Surfaces sit flat on the page. Separate regions with a rule or spacing, not a shadow.

dos: Do use `colorPalette="brand"` for the single primary action of a view, and outline for its secondary.
Do use Chakra semantic tokens (`bg`, `fg.muted`, `border.muted`) for neutrals.

Do color status text with `red.fg`, `green.fg`, `orange.fg`, or the `fg.error` / `fg.success` / `fg.warning` aliases `theme.ts` remaps to them. Chakra's default `fg.*` status values are 500/600 in light mode and fail 4.5:1 on white.
Do prefer `variant="subtle"` (sage) for green status badges and tags; a solid green tag is teal with dark ink (`green.contrast`), never white text.
Do mark the active nav item with weight + underline + `aria-current`, never color alone.
Do keep portal touch targets at least 44px tall.
Do right-align prices and format them `toLocaleString("es-AR", { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })`.
Do put theme changes in `frontend/src/components/ui/theme.ts`, not inline hex values.
Do show the brand through `BrandLogo`. Never re-tint or recolor the logo beyond its ink and cream assets, and never set the logo as text.
donts: Don't add a second accent color or decorative gradients; peach, sage, and teal are washes and state colors, not accents.
Don't separate surfaces with shadows; use 1px rules.
Don't invent mascots or product photos; none exist (see PRODUCT.md). The official logo is the only brand mark.
Don't set `fontFamily` inline; type comes from Chakra's `fonts.body` / `fonts.heading` tokens (SN Pro).
